title: This is Pokemon Lostlands - aka FFCCxPBR, a game about adventure.
author: Baphaddon

comments.author: Baphaddon
comments.body: Made this essentially relying on Claude Code and Codex, but the biggest lift was the concept of the LLM Wiki. Helped keep everything significantly more consistent. Besides this, I used a 'Claude3D' pipeline for asset mesh construction and generated textures via Flux. Also pivotal, I had Claude code build me dev tools throughout the process, like a map editor, move editor etc. Happy to answer any questions
